rationale.consistency: Follows cmdutil flag-validation idioms, mirrors pr checkout's blank-path check and develop's existing pull-warning pattern; but the requested git-client helper is absent, command strings stay hand-built in pr/shared instead.
rationale.edge_cases: Blank path, --list exclusivity, --checkout requirement, relative->absolute, reuse-existing-worktree and existing-vs-new local branch all handled; ff-only pull scoped via WithRepoDir. Help text does not state the constraints as required.
rationale.scope: Focused feature plus a needed helper move, but replaces localBranchExists (show-ref) with HasLocalBranch (rev-parse) in non-worktree pr checkout paths too, altering existing git invocations; no git.Client worktree helper as specified.
rationale.readability: Clear structure; shared helpers well commented. WorktreeCheckoutCommands' unnamed bool return and the always-passed WorktreeTarget param on checkoutBranch are slightly opaque.
rationale.robustness: Validation runs before any API mutation, errors propagate, no panics; runGitCommands wraps git errors normally. Path safety checks preserved verbatim.
rationale.maintainability: Shared resolve/validate logic deduplicated is good, but callers must interpret a bool to append sync commands, and worktree add argv is still built in pr/shared rather than a git.Client method, leaving coupling the requirement aimed to remove.
